description: Generate a new MP4 video clip (a trailer shot, cutscene or animated background) from a prompt and 1-7 reference images, saved as a new video asset in the user's Voidless library. To continue an existing video use extend_video; to make a sprite move (a walk, an attack) as game frames use animate_sprite or generate_animation_set. 15 credits per second (60 for the default 4 s), charged on every call and refunded if it fails; a run usually takes minutes and returns a job for check_generation. Returns the asset ID, the MP4 link and a thumbnail; pass the asset ID to extend_video to make it longer.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds, 4-15 (default 4). Cost is 15 credits per second

images.description: 1-7 reference images for the characters, objects and style in the clip: image keys from get_asset, https URLs, or data: URIs

prompt.description: What happens in the clip: the action, camera movement and setting, e.g. 'slow push-in on the knight drawing his sword at dusk'

width.description: Width in px (default 1280). With height it sets the aspect: 1280x720 = 16:9 landscape, 720x1280 = 9:16 portrait

name: generate_video
